answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the signal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short. The prism holds work receipts rather than names, so the shale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
